title: Ideal customer profile
body:
# Ideal customer profile

Finnish and Nordic B2B SaaS, 20-200 employees, already running an ERP or accounting system. Best fit when they feel data pain but lack a data team. Disqualify pure consultancies and pre-revenue startups.

title: Genco account plan
body:
# Genco Oy — account plan

Warm intro via Carol. They run a legacy ERP and want churn prediction. Champion is data-curious; economic buyer is the COO. Next step: a scoped pilot on their invoicing data.

title: Q3 content calendar
body:
# Q3 content calendar

Two posts a week: one predictive-DB explainer, one customer story. Anchor themes are cold-start honesty and 'your intuition as a query'.

title: Onboarding runbook
body:
# Onboarding runbook

Fresh clone plus a local Aito container to a seeded morning brief in under ten minutes. Follow the README; run the booktests; confirm the brief fits one phone screen.

title: Predictive database positioning
body:
# Predictive database positioning

Aito is the statistical layer; Claude is the reasoning layer. We sell an agent whose intuition is a database, not another dashboard. Lead with weak-and-honest predictions over confident-and-fabricated.

title: R&D roadmap themes
body:
# R&D roadmap themes

Near-term: tighten the closed loop so a logged outcome visibly moves the next brief. Later, parked: vector search and entity/graph extraction over the documents store.

title: Daily note — Genco pilot kickoff
body:
